Subject: Mutual Action Plan orientation & renewal expansion — Acme Health

Hi Jamie & Lily —

Thanks again for the productive QBR last week. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align on the renewal + expansion workstreams and make the next 6 weeks predictable for both teams. High-level goals we heard from Acme Health:

- Maintain current latency SLOs while doubling nightly batch throughput for claims enrichment.
- Roll out Redwood Optimize evaluation on one model family to reduce token cost ~20%.
- Add Data Processing Addendum (DPA) language and minor amendment for increased capacity.

Proposed immediate asks:
1) Confirm stakeholders from your side and their decision roles (technical, procurement, legal).
2) Quick usage snapshot (past 30 days) — we can generate this if easier.
3) Schedule a 45-minute MAP orientation next week to walk milestones and owners.

I've looped in Marissa (CS) to run the usage review and Sergio (SE) for a technical kickoff. Attached: MAP outline draft (Acme_MAP_v1.pdf) — this is a starting point we can adjust.

Proposed timeline (draft):
- Week 1 (this week): Stakeholder confirm + MAP orientation
- Week 2: Usage deep-dive & technical feasibility review
- Week 3–4: Pilot Optimize evaluation + contract amendment review
- Week 6: Decision window + renewal sign-off or adjustments

Would you be available for a MAP orientation on Thursday 11/23 or Friday 11/24 morning PT? If those don't work, please propose 2 slots.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Acme_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP outline, PDF)

Rachel / Marissa —

Thanks for getting this started and for the clear timeline. Quick answers from Acme:

- Stakeholders: Jamie Park (technical owner), Lily Chen (procurement), David Morales (legal; david.morales@acmehealth.com).
- Decision rhythm: Technical sign-off in Weeks 3–4, procurement/legal review Week 4–5, exec approval by Week 6.

We'd appreciate the per-route cost breakdown (helps our FinOps team). If you can generate the 30-day usage with that, great.

For the Optimize pilot: we can provide sample prompts and a sanitized dataset, but David (legal) will need to see the DPA and sample amendment before we start any data exchange. I'll put the DPA on the thread — attaching our standard DPA request. Also, procurement prefers DocuSign for amendments — can you send a prepared amendment when ready?

Thursday 11/23 9:30am PT works for the orientation for Jamie and Lily; David will join the follow-up legal review the following week.

Attachment: data_processing_addendum.pdf (Acme legal)

Best,

Great — thanks for the details, Jamie.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Marissa will deliver the per-route and aggregate 30-day usage snapshot by EOD 11/21.
- I will produce a first-pass MAP (milestones + owners) and a proposed amendment for increased capacity; Grace will own the procurement thread and prepare a DocuSign-ready amendment template.
- Sergio will scope the Optimize pilot and share required technical access items ahead of Week 2.

Attached for your review: Acme_MAP_v1.pdf (editable MAP), usage_snapshot_20261119.csv (30-day export). The MAP includes a short upsell recommendation (Redwood Optimize trial for two production model endpoints) and measurable success criteria. If the pilot meets the cost/latency goals we propose, we will include the Optimize bundle in the renewal addendum as an optional SKU.

Proposed MAP milestones (excerpt):
- 11/23: MAP orientation (45m) — confirm owners and finalize success metrics
- 11/24–11/30: Usage analysis & technical feasibility checklist
- 12/01–12/10: Optimize pilot execution (2-week trial)
- 12/10–12/16: Evaluate results; procurement & legal finalize amendment
- 12/18: Target decision (renewal + upsell sign-off)

DocuSign: we'll prepare the amendment and send a draft link to procurements@acmehealth.com once Grace & I have a final price/sku list.

Looking forward to the orientation on 11/23 at 09:30 PT. Calendar invite to follow.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
